content:
Elena (CEO): Quick weekly snapshot — short and actionable. Top priorities for the next 7 days: stability under load, cost-per-token targets, private beta launch readiness. Please read metrics below and flag blockers.

Maya (VP Product): +1. Also important: finish the privacy checklist for EU customers by Thu. Beta invites going out Friday (small cohort).

Raj (VP Eng): Status on rollouts: canary at 10% for the new cache policy, telemetry looks good so far. Will push to 30% tomorrow if no regressions.

Sam (Head SRE): Incident recap from yesterday: a memory leak in a background reloader caused three Dedicated nodes to OOM during a hot deploy. Mitigated by rollback and reducing preload concurrency. Root cause fix in PR, testing now. Impact: 12m spike in error rate, no customer-facing data loss.

Sam (Head SRE): Quick metrics snapshot (last 24h):
```
- p95 latency generation: 165ms (target < 180ms)
- tail (99.9): 1.8s (improved from 2.6s after autoscale tweak)
- errors: 0.35% (baseline 0.1% — spike due to OOM)
- tokens/day: 3.2B
- Dedicated pool saturation: 78% peak
```

Tess (Head Finance): Cost note: infra cost per 1M tokens this week ~ $135 (after discounts). Finance target is $120/1M by end of Q — need workload-level quantization + caching to reach it. Will share a breakdown tomorrow.

Grace (Eng PM): Product asks: 1) Confirm fallback policy for private beta (must be documented in card); 2) We need 2 more eval sets to check hallucination regressions before broadening invites.

Raj (VP Eng): Action items I own:
- Finish canary to 30% by EOD tomorrow if stable (status: on track)
- Deploy memory leak fix after green tests (ETA: 6h)
- Add circuit-breaker to model router to reduce blast radius

Maya (VP Product): Beta checklist highlights — all items needed for go/no-go: legal signoff (done), privacy checklist (in progress), telemetry hooks for rollback (done), support rota (assigned).

Elena (CEO): Two exec asks: 1) By end of day Wed, each functional lead posts a one-line blocker and owner in #release-war-room; 2) Finance + Eng to propose 3 cost levers we can action next week (quantization, aggressive prefix caching, smaller sequence budgets).

Tess (Head Finance): I'll prioritize a short model-cost playbook and will sync with Raj + Maya Wed 10:30am PT.

Sam (Head SRE): Will add a temporary autoscale guard and a playbook entry for the OOM signature. Also scheduling a small chaos run on the Dedicated pool Fri to validate fallbacks.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy to prod-dedicated at 2026-03-25T03:00:00Z (canary 10%). See link: https://deploys.internal/reports/2162345678

Grace (Eng PM): Noted. I'll post the two eval sets by EOD and ping QA for quick runs.

Elena (CEO): Thanks team. Quick wins this week matter — prioritize reliability + clear rollback paths over feature expansion. If you need cross-team help, drop it in #release-war-room and @me. :thumbsup:

Maya (VP Product): 👍 Any objections to extending the beta invites cadence by one week if we need the extra evals?

Elena (CEO): Fine with that — prefer a slightly later but safer launch.

Raj (VP Eng): Will report back in tomorrow's standup with canary metrics and PR link for the leak fix.

Sam (Head SRE): Will post the postmortem draft in #incidents by EOW.

Tess (Head Finance): Thanks — will send cost levers doc 10:30am Wed after sync.

Elena (CEO): Closing note: great ownership, focus on the three asks. Short daily updates in this thread are fine.
